functional_family: monotone saturating residual-coverage curve in K/N
rationale: At K/N=0.5, uniform accuracy stays near 71-73% while Zipf improves with N; the closest point, N=64 and K=32, reaches 92.1-92.4% on Zipf. Scaling to N=128 gives K=64. Concentrated lognormal traffic should help selection, while sigma=1 noise and crossing scopes add downside, making 64 the conservative smallest estimate.
